title: Pendulum Cascade: interactive simulation of the hierarchical pendulum chain
description: Static web page that runs the forced, dissipative hierarchical pendulum chain live in the browser. The integrator is a port of the Fortran code used in the accompanying paper, F. Tuteri and A. Freitas, Designing turbulence through hierarchies, arXiv:2611.04706 (2026) (IMEX-SSP3(4,3,3) scheme, link lengths and masses halving along the chain) and agrees with it to a relative error of about 1e-9 after 2000 steps. Users can change the number of links, the viscosity, the forcing and gravity, flick individual links, and follow the time-averaged energy of each link. Live version: https://andremfreitas.github.io/pendulum-web/
